title: The Sage and Pink Always-Cold Girl Christmas Gift Guide
description: A Christmas gift guide for the friend who is always freezing, all from Walmart: a Sunbeam sage heated throw, a Joyspun pink plush robe, green faux fur slippers, a 3-pack of lounge socks, a pink SweetFull mug warmer and pink bear rechargeable hand warmers.
intro: Everybody has one. The friend who shows up in July with a cardigan and asks if you can turn the AC down. This one's for her. A heated throw in sage, a pink plush robe, fuzzy green slippers, the softest lounge socks, a mug warmer so her coffee stops going cold on her desk, and two little bear hand warmers she'll keep in her coat pocket all winter. Cute, useful, and nothing she'll shove in a closet.

sections.heading: The big cozy gifts
paragraphs: The Sunbeam Luxe Plush heated throw in sage, 50 by 70 inches with 4 heat settings, and the Joyspun women's plush robe in Pink Sky.

sections.heading: The little warm-up gifts
paragraphs: The Joyspun faux fur puff scuff slippers in green, the Joyspun double layer crew lounge socks 3-pack in Pink City, the SweetFull 2-in-1 mug warmer in pink and the SWEETFULL rechargeable bear hand warmers 2-pack in pink.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The kitchen, the cocoa and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, color and size before you buy.
